Hi Karthik,

Thanks for sending over the redlines last week. Legal took a look and we have two quick asks before we can kick off DocuSign:

1) Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the signing group for the MSA (company-level exec vs VP finance) so we can line up our boarded signatory?
2) We have a local compliance requirement for our CFO-level signature to be witnessed for the MSA. Can Redwood include a witness step in the envelope (or note if that will be handled off-platform)?

Attached: Atlas_MSA_comments.pdf (redline highlights)

We'd like to get both the MSA and the Order Form executed by EOD Friday if possible — we're targeting a July 1 go-live for the pilot.

Thanks,

Atlas Health

Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA/OF — sign routing question and witness requirement

Claire — thanks, and appreciate the clear timeline. Quick plan below:

- Signing group: Redwood will sign via our VP, Finance (Laura Bennett) for the Order Form and our General Counsel (Rishi Malhotra) will countersign the MSA where required. If your legal team needs an exec-level signature instead of GC, tell me and I can escalate.
- Witnessing: We can add a witness recipient to the DocuSign envelope for the MSA. That recipient would be a non-signing witness step that records date/time and name in the audit trail. If Atlas requires an in-person notarized witness, note that DocuSign's standard witness is electronic only (E-sign witness).
- Envelope lanes: propose two parallel lanes in the envelope — Lane A: Atlas signers (Claire + CFO); Lane B: Redwood signers (Rishi + Laura) with a final post-signify witness step. This keeps both sign paths visible and the audit trail intact.

I'll confirm names/emails for the Redwood signers and upload a signature matrix. Marissa — can you open a DocuSign envelope with the two-lane flow and include a non-signing witness recipient after the final signature? Also attach the updated clean copy (MSA v3) to the envelope.

Claire — attaching the Order Form we plan to send (OrderForm_Atlas-20270627.xlsx).

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks — a couple of legal clarifications from our side: 

- Authority: I can sign the MSA on behalf of Redwood as GC for this pilot; Laura will sign the Order Form as VP Finance. If Atlas requires a CEO-level signatory on the MSA, we'll need a short approval call to escalate (let me know).
- Witnessing nuance: Electronic witness in DocuSign is fine and creates an audit log entry. If Atlas requires a separate attestation statement (e.g., name of witness printed and relationship), Marissa please add a final form field for witness name and role.
- Clean copies: After envelope completion we'll generate a clean PDF (no comments) and upload to the shared Drive folder; include version tag RINF_MSA_v3_FINAL.

Marissa — please set the envelope so that: 1) signatures are sequential per lane (Atlas lane completes, then Redwood lane), 2) non-signing witness recipient is required (must complete), and 3) we attach the final clean copy post-signing to the HubSpot deal. Also populate the signature_matrix.csv with signatory name, title, and email so Atlas can validate.

I'll be on standby for any redline follow-ups.

Rishi Malhotra
